Fictional resume: Jordan Vale
Experience
Cedar Health | Software Engineer | 2024–2026
Built a patient scheduling portal using Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL. Added appointments, eligibility checks, reminders, and staff dashboards. Worked with clinic administrators to define acceptance criteria and validate workflows before release. The scheduling portal used role-based access and audit trails for appointment updates. Designed REST endpoints for booking changes and cancellation requests. Documented operational procedures and coordinated acceptance testing with the support team. Implemented accessible form validation and responsive appointment views. Reviewed pull requests and investigated production errors. Measured response times and used database indexes to improve appointment searches. Maintained documentation for support staff and ran release-readiness reviews.

Birch Payments | Software Engineer | 2021–2023
Built a reconciliation service using Go, Redis, and Kafka. Developed batch import validation, merchant settlement reports, and retry handling. The service processed payment reconciliation events and routed failed records for review. Coordinated with finance operations on exception handling and reporting requirements. Added monitoring for delayed events and implemented consumer lag alerts. Wrote service tests and documented recovery procedures. Improved merchant reporting and reconciliation accuracy. Supported incident response and tracked operational improvements. Prepared integration documentation and reviewed changes with teammates.

General skills
Rust, Kubernetes, Terraform, MongoDB, and Python. Personal learning and general technical familiarity; no employer assignment is provided in this section.
Education
Bachelor of Computer Science. This entire resume describes a fictional person.
